description.en: Qoder International COSY signing, stream unwrap, quota windows and model catalog.
description.zh: Qoder 国际版 COSY 签名、流解码、配额窗口与模型目录。

description.en: Authorise Qoder in the browser, then this plugin polls the device token.
description.zh: 在浏览器中授权 Qoder 后，插件会轮询设备令牌。

help.en: Claim daily credits when a saved Qoder runtime-info device identity is available.
help.zh: 仅在已保存 Qoder runtime-info 真实设备身份时自动领取每日 Credits。

help.en: Paste the machineToken value from Qoder runtime-info's output. Required for international check-in.
help.zh: 粘贴 Qoder runtime-info 输出的 machineToken；国际版签到必需。

help.en: Paste the machineType value from the same runtime-info output.
help.zh: 粘贴同一 runtime-info 输出的 machineType。
